images.alt:
Screenshots of recommendations of council's feedback on TOUC scheme

i. agree with having nationally consistent vehicle classes.

ii. recommend the ‘truck’ class (Class D) is reviewed with a view to
splitting medium goods vehicles from heavy goods vehicles.

iii. opposed to charging ratios being set nationally due to the risk this
poses to effective charge setting and the objectives of the
legislation.

iv. recommend that charging ratios are proposed by Scheme Boards,
based on local conditions, for ratification by relevant local
authorities and approval by Ministers.

v. recommend that, if national ratios are retained, the ratio applying to
heavy and medium goods vehicles and motorbikes / mopeds is
reviewed.

The motion was declared CARRIED on voices.
